subtitle: Digital product store: courses, e-books, guides, templates and bundles
headline: Customers can now browse, pay with Payfast, and automatically receive their downloads, course links and receipt by email. Staff have a secure admin sign-in with two-step verification. Remaining work is the admin tools (refunds, products, orders, reporting), the client's real content, and the staging and go-live steps.

milestones.name: Store on the database, checkout, polished look
milestones.detail: Catalogue from DB, Payfast checkout, reference-matched design

milestones.name: First real sale, paid and delivered
milestones.detail: Code complete. The live sandbox purchase on staging waits for Payfast sandbox account + staging site (D16)

milestones.name: Admin and operations
milestones.detail: Admin sign-in done; refunds, products, orders, reporting remain

milestones.name: Launch
milestones.detail: Client content, compliance, staging, runbooks, go-live and client sign-off

modules.name: Repository foundation and CI
modules.delivered: Automated checks on every change (type checks, tests, browser tests, secret scanning), pinned tools, PR template, architecture decision records.

modules.name: Database, security rules and audit log
modules.delivered: All tables, default-deny access rules, integrity rules (orders can't be altered or deleted), append-only audit log; 160+ database tests.

modules.name: Catalogue from the database, SEO pages
modules.delivered: Shop built from the database; a pre-rendered, search-friendly page per product; sitemap; one licence per product.

modules.name: Payfast checkout (rands) + home page polish
modules.delivered: Server-priced checkout in ZAR (R1 997.00 format), coupons, R5 minimum, pending orders, honest success page; shop restyled to match the reference site.

modules.name: Payment confirmation (Payfast ITN)
modules.delivered: All four Payfast security checks; an order is marked paid exactly once; forged or repeated notifications can't do harm; safe replay tool.

modules.name: Secure downloads
modules.delivered: Private file storage; personal download links valid 7 days / 5 downloads (D5); email-scanner-safe download page; 60-second file links.

modules.name: Delivery emails
modules.delivered: One email per order with receipt, download buttons and course links; honest manual-access wording; retries if the email service is down; owner alerts. Resend Free plan (D9, review D18).

modules.name: Admin sign-in and staff roles
modules.delivered: Admin login with mandatory authenticator app; owner/admin/support roles checked on server and database; staff tool (add, reset, revoke); activity log. Carmen is owner (D10).

modules.name: Refunds and chargebacks
modules.needs: Decisions D7 (refund policy) and D15 (API vs dashboard)
modules.scope: Refund from the admin through Payfast (or record a dashboard refund), mark disputes, revoke access to refunded items, refund email.

modules.name: Product management (admin)
modules.scope: Create and edit products, prices, categories, bundles and coupons; upload files; course links and instructions; 'Publish changes' button.

modules.name: Order management (admin)
modules.scope: Search orders; see payments, deliveries and emails; resend emails; renew or revoke links; confirm manual access; replay failed payments.

modules.name: Sales reporting and monitoring
modules.scope: Sales dashboard (orders, revenue, refunds, top products, VAT/net); automatic health checks that email the owner when something fails.

modules.name: Content, compliance and final polish
modules.needs: Carmen's content; decisions D3, D7, D12, D13
modules.scope: Real copy, products, photos and legal pages (POPIA); reviews; newsletter consent; accessibility and speed checks; page-by-page design sign-off.

modules.name: Staging and go-live
modules.needs: Accounts in Carmen's name; decisions D9 (plans), D16 (Payfast)
modules.scope: Staging site with Payfast sandbox and a real test purchase; runbooks, backups and restore test; go-live checklist; Carmen's acceptance testing.
